blurb: Ann Arbor Golf and Outing Club offers membership with initiation fees, annual dues, and food minimums. The golf course has 18 holes with detailed descriptions of holes 4/13 through 9/18, highlighting challenges and features of each hole. Membership requires sponsorship by two current members and includes various user fees and optional services.
extraNote: Non-refundable application fee is $100 · Membership dues are paid annually and are due on January 31
